# @kahf/design

The parent design system of the Kahf family. kahflabs.com and every product site (qasd, mizwala, wasl, coder
.kahflabs.com) are built on it. Each child site then adds its own touches: its accent through its `kf-scope-*`
class, its own stylesheet, its own pages and screens.

```
styles/kahf.css      Family tokens (colour, type, shape, motion), light and dark, every product's accent scope.
                     GENERATED by `npm run css` from source/ — edit the source, not this file.
styles/product.css   The product-site layer: hero with phones, strengths, steps, facts, legal prose.
components/          Button, Eyebrow, Header, Footer, Icon, Logo, Mark, Phone, SectionHead, SpecList, Steps, …
layouts/             Base (every product page), Legal (privacy, terms).
lib/                 Product type and URL helpers, brand marks, icons, sitemap.
scripts/site.ts      Theme toggle, mobile nav, copy buttons.
public/              IBM Plex (OFL) and theme.js, copied into each site's public/ at build.
integration.mjs      The Astro integration (below).
tools/               headers.mjs, build_css.py, and two CLIs: kahf-assets, kahf-screens.
source/              The design canvas exports kahf.css is built from.
```

## Using it in a site

```jsonc
// package.json
"dependencies": { "astro": "7.3.5", "@kahf/design": "github:Ahmad-AlModhayan/kahf-design#v1.0.0" }
```

```js
// astro.config.mjs
import kahf from '@kahf/design/integration';
export default defineConfig({ site: 'https://<id>.kahflabs.com', integrations: [kahf({ styles: '/src/styles/site.css' })] });
```

```astro
---
import Base from '@kahf/design/layouts/Base.astro';
import Button from '@kahf/design/components/Button.astro';
---
```

The integration copies `public/` (fonts, theme.js) into the site, loads the site's `styles` file after the family
CSS on every page (so a child's rule always wins a tie), and writes `dist/_headers`. Pass
`headers: { forms: true, endpoint }` for a site with a form, or `headers: false` to skip it.

Add `public/fonts/` and `public/theme.js` to the site's `.gitignore`; they are copied on every dev and build.

## Child touches

| Where | What |
|---|---|
| `kahf.css` → `.kf-scope-<id>` | The product's accent, from the family palette. Set `scope` in the site's `product.ts`. |
| `src/styles/site.css` | Anything only that product has (Mizwala's Asr sky, Wasl's disclosure card, Coder's note). |
| `src/Home.astro` | The page itself, in both languages. |
| `kahf.assets.json` + `npx kahf-assets` | Favicons, app icons, manifest and social images, from the product's mark. |
| `npx kahf-screens` | Phone screens rendered from the product's design canvas into `public/screens`. |

## Releasing

Change, bump `version`, tag `vX.Y.Z`, push the tag. Sites move when their `#vX.Y.Z` is bumped, never by accident.
This repository is private for now. Hosts (Netlify, Vercel) need read access to install it; see the site READMEs.
